Name: MisoMegu's Foxes
Author: MisoMegu
Description:
[center][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/YkSTDFU.png[/img]
─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

This mod adds foxes to Marnie's shop!
I have ALL the shades of foxes! All 94 colors!
(Let me know if I somehow missed any though!)
They will harvest truffles for you and when they trust you enough, they may even dig up their treasures for you that they snatched from around town! But keep an eye out for sneaky Tanuki that might try to use their disguise magic to sneak in and steal your fox's truffles!


─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Compatible with 1.6
Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]If you don't want to play Fox Gacha, I recommend a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] so you can manually chose the foxes you want.
I am always open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!﻿
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!

─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pN61w0v.png[/img]﻿
─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Current Version 1.1.1

1.1.1: Fixed Piebald's baby sprite error and fixed Colicott Marble, Smokey, Pink Champagne Marble, and Silver Colicott's errors and should be added to Marnie's now!
1.1.0: The foxes will now bring gifts when you raise their friendships ♥

─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Planned Updates:
More variety eye colors, more fox sounds, and adding my own manual shadows.

This will become a base mod and in the future I plan to add future add-ons! That way you can pick and choose what foxes you want to add to the fox gacha!

Planned Add-Ons are desert foxes, other foxes (ex: Bat-Ear), my OC foxes, and I plan on doing a pack with detailed fox sanctuary foxes, like Finnegan, Dixie Doo, Juniper, Porsha, and a ton more. I even want to give each fox their own audio files from the fox themselves! I plan on this for maybe mid-late 2026.
Any money earned from that pack will go directly to the sanctuaries ♥
